architecture.summary: CI tooling only: a manual GitHub Actions workflow builds Dockerfile.hosted once on a native AMD64 runner, runs the hosted image gate against that image through the new test setting THERMUS_HOSTED_GATE_IMAGE, and pushes the tested image to GHCR by commit; the missing-portal case of the gate mounts its empty anonymous volume without readonly, which the Docker Engine 28.0.4 of the runner refuses. No source, runtime, registry view, declaration, or deployment changes; the Slice 1 evidence record, the gate policy, and the README describe the workflow and its runs.
